entries.headline: injection probability 0.99 while page remained readable
entries.control: README narrative/example only; no labelled corpus or independent control committed.
entries.finding: Quoted README claim only; no source-side control or re-run.

entries.headline: contradicted claim caught at confidence 1.0 against a city ordinance
entries.control: No ordinance fixture, claim/evidence pair, or independent control in checkout.

entries.headline: 6,257 traces; Who 73.4, When 76.4, All 31.3; $1.28
entries.control: RESULTS includes CIs, gpt-5.4 baseline, ECE, pricing and tests.
entries.finding: Source control opened, but no surviving candidate depends on this surface.

entries.headline: TF-IDF needs 100–10,000 labels to match; shifted mail loses 20+ points
entries.control: Five-draw learning curves at 25..10,000 labels; OOD files and multiple seeds.
entries.finding: Range is dataset-specific: email logistic reaches parity near 1,000/10,000, Ling-Spam near 200, three-category near 100; broad wording hides the split.

entries.headline: verdict 62.6 vs 81.3; five signals + fitted head 95.1; AUROC .988; ECE .027; fixed 89.5
entries.control: Control 1 no-AI 91.6; Control 2 A/B split; Controls 3-5 alternative LLM/verdict wording/dataset knowledge.
entries.finding: Numbers reappear in source; interpretation is repriced 62.6→91.6 (+29.0)→95.1 (+3.5), then Q10 shows two-signal concentration.

entries.headline: 662 injection messages and 200 vulnerable-code pairs
entries.control: No-context/with-context comparison; vulnerable-code pair setup; internal label audit.
entries.finding: Corpus sizes survive; source warns accuracy is affected by context and noisy secure labels.

entries.headline: 45% reduction, zero text loss; summary won 3–1 at one-third bytes
entries.control: Replay receipt and three A/B receipts with q1-q3; same-fixture rerun exists.
entries.finding: Reduction 2047→1136 (44.43%) survives; 3–1 B-wins does not: reruns are 1–1 and 1–3, exposing generator variance.

entries.headline: ECE .061, Brier .020, Noul 58/60, Choice 19/20
entries.control: 80-row hashed fixture; metrics n=60, bins, threshold coverage, choice accuracy.
entries.finding: Receipt matches numbers; no external transfer claim.

entries.headline: TypeSafe four-workflow average 67.8% agreement
entries.control: Raw 11-sweep/716-item artifact absent; public account says references were model-averaged, not human ground truth.
entries.finding: Ceiling not locally rederived and is agreement-to-reference, not correctness.
